description: CYSN → CYKF direct, alternate CYHM, departing 2026-09-14 15:00Z, C172 VFR day at 3,500 ft. NOTAMs from the NAV CANADA corpus recorded 2026-09-12. Labels were produced by a three-perspective panel (instructor, safety-minded private pilot, flight service specialist) with majority vote; they are PROVISIONAL until the owner reviews them. Agreement per item is in the note.

labels.note: 2/3 — Runway surface condition report for CYKF that expires Sep 13 0036Z, before the flight, and reports all surfaces dry. No operational effect; a newer RSC should be checked on the day.
3/3 — PAPI out for the closed 06/24 at CYHM; a diversion would land on 12/30, so this is background knowledge only.
3/3 — Runway identification lights for RWY 24 at the alternate out; daytime, and 06/24 is closed, so no effect on this flight.
3/3 — Taxiway closure at the alternate; would only affect taxi routing after a diversion landing on 12/30 and ground control will route around it. Worth knowing, not decisive.
3/3 — Taxiway B edge lighting unserviceable at CYHM; day VFR and TWY B is closed in any case, so no operational effect on a diversion.
3/3 — Edge lights out on a section of RWY 06/24 at the alternate; the runway is closed and the flight is by day, so this changes nothing operationally.
labels.cited_span: REDL 06/24 BTN TWY B AND TWY C U/S

labels.note: 3/3 — Instrument approach restriction at CYHM for a runway that is closed anyway; IFR-only item for a VFR flight.
labels.cited_span: RNAV (GNSS) Z RWY 06 AND RNAV (GNSS) Z RWY 24 APCH: NOT AUTH

labels.note: 2/3 — ARFF category availability schedule for scheduled passenger operations; a private VFR C172 has no ARFF requirement at the alternate.
labels.cited_span: DESIGNATED CAT 7 AVBL FOR SKED PAX FLT

labels.note: 3/3 — The crosswind runway at the alternate is closed for the whole period, leaving only 12/30 at CYHM. A diversion there must be planned on 12/30 regardless of wind, so crosswind limits for the alternate need checking; also note the closed runway is in use as a taxiway.
labels.cited_span: RWY 06/24 CLSD AVBL AS TWY BTN TWY C AND TWY F

labels.note: 3/3 — Prohibition applies only to Russian/Belarusian-connected aircraft and operators; not applicable to a Canadian-registered private C172.
labels.cited_span: PROHIBITED TO ENTER, EXIT OR OVERFLY CANADA'S TERRITORIAL AIRSPACE

labels.note: 3/3 — Airspace security warning for Yangon FIR; geopolitical item about another region.
3/3 — Airspace security warning for Dakar/Niamey FIRs over Mali; nothing to do with a southern Ontario VFR flight.
3/3 — Administrative trigger NOTAM for AIP/CFS/CAP amendments; no operational effect on this flight beyond carrying current publications.
labels.cited_span: TRIGGER NOTAM - PERM AIRAC AIP AMDT

labels.note: 3/3 — GPS jamming exercise centred near Grayling MI; the flight is only about 200 NM from centre (outside the 137 NM/4000 ft AGL ring) and the D) schedule is DAILY 0400-1059Z, well before the 14:00-16:46Z window. Worth knowing for a basic-GNSS aircraft but not active during the flight; navigate by pilotage/VOR anyway.
labels.cited_span: GNSS SIGNAL MAY BE PERIODICALLY INTERRUPTED

labels.note: 3/3 — Unlit crane to 580 ft AMSL in central Hamilton near the McMaster heliport, roughly 5 NM north of CYHM and a few miles north of the CYKF-CYHM diversion track. Well below cruise altitude and off the approach paths to 12/30; a heliport-area obstacle to be aware of when descending into the Hamilton control zone, not a decisive factor.
labels.cited_span: CRANE 431528N 0795435W (APRX 5920FT SE AD (CPJ3)). 256FT AGL 580FT AMSL. NOT LGTD, PAINTED.

labels.note: 3/3 — Non-standard markings on the landing runway at CYKF during construction; combined with the displaced threshold the pilot should brief what the threshold will look like, but it does not change whether the flight can be flown.

3/3 — Lighted 120 ft AGL crane near CYKF, active 1100-2300Z on 14 Sep so it covers the arrival, but it sits 4580 ft SW of the RWY 32 extended centreline and well clear of the 08/26 approach paths; worth a look in the circuit, not decisive.
labels.cited_span: MOBILE CRANE WITHIN 66FT RADIUS CENTRED ON 432641N 0802319W APRX 570FT BFR THR 32 AND 4580FT SW EXTENDED RCL. 120FT AGL

labels.note: 3/3 — A taxiway closure at the departure aerodrome; with 11/29 also closed the taxi route to 01/19 is constrained. Not decisive on its own, but the pilot should confirm the taxi routing with ground/ATIS before starting.

3/3 — Closure of the second runway at the departure aerodrome leaves only the shortened 01/19; crosswind options are gone, so runway choice and crosswind limits must be checked against the wind at 15:00Z.

3/3 — Cluster of unlit, unpainted cranes to 512 ft AMSL about 2 NM NW of CYSN, right in the sector a C172 climbing out of RWY 01/19 and turning onto the ~287 deg track to Waterloo will pass through at low altitude. Departure obstacle near the planned path; brief it and climb clear before turning on course.
labels.cited_span: MULTIPLE CRANES WITHIN 1000FT RADIUS CENTRED ON 431252N 0791228W APRX 1.4NM BFR THR 11 AND 1.1NM NORTH EXTENDED RCL. 213FT AGL 512FT AMSL. NOT LGTD, NOT PAINTED.

labels.note: 3/3 — With 11/29 closed, 01/19 is the only runway at CYSN. Displaced threshold 19 due trees shortens declared distances (TORA 2498, LDA 19 1975) and puts a 50 ft AGL obstacle just short of THR 19; still adequate for a C172 but the pilot must plan takeoff performance and any return-to-land on the shortened runway.
labels.cited_span: THR 19 DISPLACED BY 523FT DUE TREES 550FT BFR THR 19 AND 100FT W EXTENDED RCL

labels.note: 3/3 — ILS outage is an IFR-only item; a VFR C172 with no IFR capability does not use it.
3/3 — IFR approach minima and SID changes for CYKF while THR 26 is displaced; not applicable to a VFR arrival.
labels.cited_span: ILS RWY 26 APCH: ILS/DME MINIMA: NOT AUTH

labels.note: 3/3 — Instrument approach minima changes and SID restrictions for RWY 08/26 at CYKF; the flight is VFR with no IFR capability and is not departing CYKF.
labels.cited_span: RNAV (GNSS) Z RWY 08 APCH: LPV AND LNAV/VNAV MINIMA: NOT AUTH

labels.note: 3/3 — PAPI for RWY 26 is unavailable during the arrival window, so no vertical guidance on final to the displaced threshold; a VFR pilot can fly a visual approach without it, but should expect no glidepath aid and be wary of the closed first 1000 ft.
3/3 — Runway edge lights on 08/26 out during the daytime construction window covering the arrival; not a factor for a day VFR landing, though it matters if the flight is delayed toward dusk.
3/3 — High-intensity approach lights for RWY 26 out during the arrival window; the referenced AIP procedure concerns instrument approaches and day VFR is unaffected.

3/3 — D) schedule SEP 14 1100-2100Z covers the 15:32Z arrival. If landing RWY 26 the pilot must aim for the displaced threshold and not touch down in the closed first 1000 ft; declared distances change (LDA 6003, still ample for a C172). Construction on the runway is a must-know for the destination.
labels.cited_span: THR 26 DISPLACED BY 1000FT DUE CONST. FIRST 1000FT RWY 26 CLSD.

labels.note: 3/3 — Approach lighting for RWY 08 at CYKF is out through 14 Sep 2100Z, so it covers the arrival, but approach lights are of no consequence for a day VFR arrival.
2/3 — CYHM runway surface condition report expired Sep 12 2327Z, before the flight, and reported dry surfaces; no operational effect.
3/3 — Unlit antenna 2.1 NM WSW of CYSN at 495 ft AMSL; light out is immaterial for a day VFR departure, but the tower itself is in the general direction of departure toward Waterloo.
labels.cited_span: OBST LGT U/S ANTENNA 431042N 0791257W (APRX 2.1NM WSW AD) 167FT AGL
